parameters.name: page[after]
parameters.description:
Pointer to paginate to retrieve the data after the object provided. Specify the `base64` encoded JSON string in a **uniquely identifiable** manner (e.g. object IDs), i.e. by using one (primary) or two (primary and secondary) fields that allow for **stable** sorting.
            

Format: `{"primary":{"someField": 123},"secondary":{"someOtherOptionalField": "Foo"}}`
            

Example: `{"primary":{"crackerBinaryId": 123}}` -> `eyJwcmltYXJ5Ijp7ImNyYWNrZXJCaW5hcnlJZCI6IDEyM319`

parameters.name: page[before]
parameters.description:

Format: `{"primary":{"someField": 123},"secondary":{"someOtherOptionalField": "Foo"}}`
            

Example: `{"primary":{"crackerBinaryId": 123}}` -> `eyJwcmltYXJ5Ijp7ImNyYWNrZXJCaW5hcnlJZCI6IDEyM319`

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token cookie for a new access token
post.description:
Reads the refreshToken cookie set by /api/v2/auth/token, rotates it and answers
          with a new access token. Needs no Authorization header, so it keeps working once the previous
          access token has expired. The rotated cookie is returned in Set-Cookie; the token itself is
          never part of the body.

Set-Cookie.description:
The rotated refresh token, scoped to /api/v2/auth/refresh and marked HttpOnly.
        Replaces the cookie sent with the request, which is consumed by this call.

schema.example: refreshToken=4fa1371293a112224bc930cf9fecd0fd; Path=/api/v2/auth/refresh; Max-Age=1209600; Expires=Wed, 30 Sep 2026 07:02:31 GMT; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

401.description: The refresh token is missing, expired, revoked or already used

delete.description:
Revokes the session the refreshToken cookie belongs to and clears the cookie.
          Sessions on other devices are left alone. Logging out without a cookie is not an error.

Set-Cookie.description:
The refresh token cookie, emptied and expired so the client drops it. Carries
        the same attributes it was set with, which is what makes a browser replace rather than keep it.

schema.example: refreshToken=; Path=/api/v2/auth/refresh; Max-Age=0; Expires=Wed, 16 Sep 2026 07:02:31 GMT; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

403.description: The request origin is not allowed to send credentials

parameters.name: Upload-Metadata
parameters.description:
The Upload-Metadata header contains one or more comma-separated key-value pairs.
            Each pair is formatted as `<key> <base64(value)>`, where:
              - `key` is a string without spaces.
              - `value` is base64-encoded

parameters.name: Upload-Length
parameters.description:
The total size of the upload in bytes. Must be a positive integer.
          Required if `Upload-Defer-Length` is not set.

parameters.name: Upload-Defer-Length
parameters.description:
Indicates that the upload length is not known at creation time.
          Value must be `1`. If present, `Upload-Length` must be omitted.

Tus-Resumable.description:
Indicates the TUS version the server supports.
        Must always be set to `1.0.0` in compliant servers.

Location.description: Location of the file where the user can push to.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: The Upload-Offset header's value MUST be equal to the current offset of the resource

requestBody.description: The binary data to push to the file

version.description: Version of the cracker this binary holds.

downloadUrl.description: External http or https url the agent downloads the binary archive from. The server keeps a local copy for later analysis: it is fetched on creation, and changing the url fetches it again, the change being rejected when the download fails or the archive is not a valid 7z file. Mutually exclusive with sourceType, which points this url at the download endpoint of this server and then makes it unchangeable.

binaryName.description: Name of the executable inside the archive that the agent runs.

filename.description: Name of the locally stored 7z archive, null while the binary is downloaded from downloadUrl. Cannot be set.

accessGroupId.description: Access group this cracker binary belongs to. Required on creation, where the requesting user must be a member, and changeable only by a user who belongs to both the current and the new group.

sourceType.description:
Where the 7z archive is uploaded from. Mutually exclusive with downloadUrl.

One of:

* `inline` - The archive is the base64 encoded sourceData of this request
* `import` - The archive is taken from the file in the import directory that sourceData names
* `url` - The archive is fetched by the server from the http(s) url in sourceData

isSmall.description: Whether the task is small, in which case only ever one agent is assigned to it.

isCpuTask.description: Whether the task is meant for CPU agents rather than for agents with a GPU.

useNewBench.description: Whether agents benchmark this task by speed rather than by runtime. Sent to the agent as benchType.

skipKeyspace.description: How much of the keyspace to leave out at the beginning of the task.

staticChunks.description:
How the keyspace of the task is cut into chunks. Anything but the default reads the chunk size from chunkSize instead of benchmarking the agent.

One of:

* `0` - Size every chunk from the benchmark of the agent and the chunk time of the task
* `1` - Give every chunk the fixed size held in chunkSize
* `2` - Split the keyspace into the number of equally sized chunks held in chunkSize
